rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive project tracking server that manages the complete software development lifecycle with SQLite-based persistence. Provides structured management of epics, user stories, tasks, bugs, and test cases with stakeholder ownership workflows and audit trails. Features include automatic status transitions (bugs reopen closed stories, QA stories reopen epics), epic-to-epic and story-to-story dependency tracking, integrated wiki system with entity linking, collaborative commenting across all entities, and knowledge graph generation for codebases in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Java. Built with better-sqlite3 and Zod validation, creating a local .project_tracker.db file in the specified project directory.
